content: Speaking-practice apps (ELSA, Speeko, Yoodli) center on: a prompt/topic, timed recording, and post-session feedback report (pace, filler words, pronunciation score). ELSA has a shadowing mode + interview coach; Speeko gives a report card after each session and adapts lesson difficulty. Common thread: record -> analyze -> feedback loop, monetized via subscription with AI scoring as the paid differentiator.
